# kilhog Provider

Interact with the Kilhog IPAM API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "kilhog" {
  base_url = "http://localhost:8080"
  # api_key = var.kilhog_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Kilhog API key sent as a Bearer token. May also be set via the `KILHOG_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Kilhog API base URL. May also be set via the `KILHOG_BASE_URL` environment variable. Defaults to `http://localhost:8080`.
